Bill Hader hasn’t appeared in a major Pixar/Disney animated feature yet, so unfortunately there isn’t a single film that satisfies *both* conditions perfectly. If having Bill Hader in the lineup is essential, here are two alternatives that do feature him in animated form—though neither is directed by Josh Cooley:

| **The Simpsons Movie** | 2007 | Voiced several minor characters (e.g., “Krusty the Clown” cameo) |
| **The Lego Batman Movie** | 2017 | Voiced the Joker (in a brief cameo) |

If you’re open to watching a different director’s work while enjoying Bill Hader’s voice talent, those would be good picks. Otherwise, *Toy Story 4* remains the closest match to your original specification. Enjoy!
